signals.name: SentinelOne
signals.thesis: Cybersecurity software in a clean momentum leg: price 12% above the 50-DMA, RSI ~69, net-cash balance sheet (EV < market cap). Riding the AI-endpoint security bid without extension risk. No earnings until Aug 27.

signals.name: GitLab
signals.thesis: DevSecOps platform reclaiming trend, RSI ~69, forward PE ~32 with net cash. Momentum resuming toward the 200-DMA (33.4) after basing; AI-code-assist attach rate is the driver. Earnings clear until Sep 2.

signals.name: DoorDash
signals.thesis: Breakout continuation off a multi-week base, +3.9% on the session with volume. Local delivery + ads take-rate expansion; net cash. Well below the 285 prior high, so room before supply. Earnings Aug 5.

signals.name: Cisco Systems
signals.thesis: Textbook pullback to the 50-DMA (111) inside a primary uptrend, RSI ~43 reset. AI-networking order book + net cash + 2.5% yield give a defensive tilt in a semis-led wobble. Earnings not until Aug 12.

signals.name: Edwards Lifesciences
signals.thesis: Medtech breakout pressing the 52-week high (96.29), TAVR + structural-heart franchise, net cash. Low-beta quality that held up while risk assets sold. Note: earnings Jul 23 caps the swing window.

signals.name: Sea Ltd
signals.thesis: Southeast-Asia platform (Shopee/Garena/SeaMoney) in a momentum recovery, +16% above the 50-DMA off deeply depressed levels. Shopee GMV re-acceleration is the catalyst. Not Sharia-compliant (fintech lending + gaming). Earnings Aug 11.

signals.name: Ryanair
signals.thesis: Europe low-cost leader breaking to fresh highs, forward PE ~12.5, net cash, record summer traffic + fare recovery. Cleanest EU breakout in the pool. Horizon trimmed to 8d: fiscal-Q1 earnings Jul 20 — exit before if unresolved.

signals.name: Prysmian
signals.thesis: Cabling/grid-infra leader pulling back to the 50-DMA (145 area breached, holding above the rising 200-DMA at 107). Electrification + data-center power capex backlog. Buy-the-dip in a structural uptrend. Earnings Jul 30.

signals.name: iShares MSCI USA Momentum
signals.thesis: Broad US momentum-factor ETF resting on its 50-DMA (310) after a shallow -4% dip from the 20-DMA. Diversified way to re-engage risk-on breadth without single-name gap risk. Equity-only, no leverage.

signals.name: Exelixis
signals.thesis: Oncology franchise (cabozantinib + zanzalintinib pipeline) breaking to a new 52-week high on a beat-and-raise trajectory, forward PE ~14 — rare value+momentum overlap. Net cash. Earnings Aug 4.
